definitionZh: 填充 CSS 属性定义了 SVG 文本内容和 SVG 形状的内部画布是如何填充或绘画的. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.
sourceDefinition: The fill CSS property defines how SVG text content and the interior canvas of SVG shapes are filled or painted. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
